## What happened?

Describe the observed problem and what you expected instead.

## Steps to reproduce

Include the workspace, entity/finding or exact sequence of actions. If the problem involves a table, include its column names and a small synthetic reproduction you are allowed to share.

<!-- Keep private experiment tables, personal information and credentials out of public issues. -->

## Environment

Browser/device, viewport if relevant, and the dataset version or local commit if known. Include error text or a screenshot when useful.
